about.title:
The manufacturing partner
first-time founders need
about.description: Founded by a manufacturing executive who led roughly 200 supplement products to market. Formulation, production, packaging and distribution — finished in one place.
about.missionTitle:
We take on the complexity
of getting a product made.
about.missionBody:
The hardest part of starting a supplement business is rarely the manufacturing itself — it is not knowing where to begin.

Sourcing materials, choosing a dosage form, meeting minimum order quantities, clearing advertising review: decisions pile up at every practical step. Our CEO worked through that process across roughly 200 products as a manufacturing executive, and sorts it out for you.
about.missionCardTitle: What stands between an idea and a launch
missionBarriers: Finding a GMP plant you can trust
Minimum order quantities that are hard to meet
Securing compliant materials with stable supply
Choosing the right dosage form and packaging
Sales channels and marketing after launch
about.missionAnswer: Healthy Farm Bio brings these steps together, so you can design production with nothing more than a product concept.

floor taught us

features.title: ≈200 products of experience
features.body: Our CEO led roughly 200 products as vice president of a supplement manufacturer. That judgement lets you skip the trial and error.

qc.title:
Checked three times
before it ships
qc.description: Incoming materials, work in progress and finished goods are tested at each stage by the partner plant's lab, and we review every certificate.
qc.intro:
In this industry a single quality incident can take down an entire brand.

We place an inspection gate at every stage from incoming material to finished goods, and keep test reports and production records per lot. If something goes wrong, we can trace which lot and which material it came from.
bullets: Microbial limits (total plate count, coliforms, yeast, mould)
Form-specific physical tests — disintegration, hardness, moisture

features.title: GMP operation
features.body: Every process is managed under Good Manufacturing Practice for health functional foods.

features.title: HACCP applied
features.body: Critical control points block contamination and foreign matter risk upstream.

features.title: Lot traceability
features.body: Two-way tracing from raw material lot to shipped lot.

features.title: Test reports supplied
features.body: A finished-product test report ships with every lot.

features.title: Regular training
features.body: Production staff receive scheduled hygiene and quality training.

features.title: Third-party verification
features.body: Cross-verification by accredited laboratories on request.

faq.q: Can I request test reports separately?
faq.a: Yes. A finished-product report per shipped lot is standard, and we can commission accredited laboratories for additional items.

faq.q: What happens if a quality issue occurs?
faq.a: We isolate the cause through lot tracing and agree on a response. Where manufacturing is at fault we re-produce or compensate.

faq.q: Can we audit the factory?
faq.a: Yes. With prior arrangement you can inspect our facility and quality system in person.

oemOdm.title:
Launch fast on
a proven formulation
oemOdm.description: OEM to use an existing proven formulation, ODM to design one from the ingredient up. We do both.
oemOdm.intro:
With OEM you put your brand on a formulation we have already validated. Development time and cost stay low, which suits a first product or a line extension.

With ODM we design from ingredient selection upward. It takes longer, but the result is hard for a competitor to copy. We help you judge which route fits during the first consultation.
bullets: OEM — you want to launch within three months on a proven formulation
OEM — you want minimal upfront capital and market feedback first
ODM — your ingredient profile must not overlap with competitors
ODM — you want to secure your own patent or exclusive ingredient

faq.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
faq.a: It depends on the dosage form. Tablets and hard capsules start from 1,000 units; soft capsules and liquids are higher. We confirm exact figures during consultation.

faq.q: How long does development take?
faq.a: OEM takes roughly 6–10 weeks after contract. ODM takes roughly 3–6 months including formulation development.

faq.q: Can you handle package design?
faq.a: Yes, from carton and label design through to printing.

faq.q: Who handles labelling review?
faq.a: We draft the label copy and review the regulatory approach together with you.

material.title:
Differentiate at
the ingredient level
material.description: Apply our proprietary ingredients, or develop a new material through to individual approval.
material.intro:
Recombining ingredients that everyone already has rarely produces differentiation.

We hold patented ingredients of our own, so competitors cannot use the same combination. Where it helps, we will source a new material and pursue individual approval with you.

features.title: Proprietary ingredients
features.body: Individually approved and patented materials applied immediately.

features.title: New material discovery
features.body: We search domestic and overseas materials and review the evidence base.

features.title: Human trials
features.body: We design the study and coordinate with trial institutions.

features.title: Approval filing
features.body: Full process from dossier preparation to approval.

features.title: Marker standardization
features.body: We establish material specifications and test methods.

features.title: Patent strategy
features.body: Composition patents to secure your rights.

faq.q: How long does individual approval take?
faq.a: Typically two to four years depending on the material and available evidence. Our existing approved ingredients can be applied immediately.

faq.q: Who owns a jointly developed ingredient?
faq.a: It is defined at contract stage under the co-development terms. Exclusive licensing is negotiable.

cdmo.title:
Development and supply
under one contract
cdmo.description: Integrated contract development and manufacturing for quasi-drugs and health foods.
cdmo.intro:
When the developer and the manufacturer are different companies, accountability blurs the moment something goes wrong.

Under CDMO a single party owns formulation development, regulatory response and mass production. Communication overhead drops, and because manufacturability is considered during development, scale-up rarely stalls.
bullets: Support for registration and filing documents

dtc.title:
One sachet
for one person
dtc.description: Personalized combinations built from DTC genetic testing results and lifestyle questionnaires.
dtc.intro:
Selling the same product to everyone is on its way out.

We derive each individual's required nutrients from genetic testing and lifestyle data, then design the sachet packing and subscription delivery around it. The brand gains customer data, and customers stop churning.

faq.q: Do we have to find a testing lab ourselves?
faq.a: No. We connect you with partner laboratories and support the results integration.

faq.q: What scale do we need to start?
faq.a: Subscription models do not require large initial volume. We run a simulation during consultation.

Pet supplements,
held to the same standard
pet.description: Produced in facilities held to the same hygiene standard as our human products.
pet.intro:
The pet supplement market is growing quickly, but few manufacturers hold themselves to human-grade quality standards.

We produce pet products in the same GMP-level facility as our human health functional foods, and design palatability alongside the formulation.

faq.q: Do we need a cosmetics distribution licence?
faq.a: The brand needs one in Korea. We guide you through registration and plan the schedule around it.

faq.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
faq.a: It depends on the formulation and container. Share your concept and volume and we will confirm during consultation.

faq.q: Can we run this together with supplements?
faq.a: Yes. Inner-beauty and skincare sets are common, and one manager handles both lines.

faq.q: Can you handle packaging and cartons?
faq.a: Yes — container selection (tube, pump, airless) and carton design. If you already have artwork we apply it as is.

marketing.title:
We don't stop
at manufacturing
marketing.description: The real work starts once the product exists. We help with detail pages, marketplace listings and ad campaigns.
marketing.intro:
A good product that nobody hears about becomes inventory.

Across roughly 200 products we have watched which products sell on which channels. We put that to work on the steps after manufacturing — pick only what you need.

features.subtitle: Structure first, review rules built in
features.body: On a detail page, order converts — not length. We plan the sequence first, then write it while checking every functional claim against the review standard.
points: Structure planned around the buying flow

features.title: Product photography
features.subtitle: Cut-outs, styled shots, page assets
features.body: Online, the photo is the product. From cut-outs for thumbnails to styled shots in use, we deliver files ready to upload to each channel.

features.title: Channel onboarding
features.subtitle: Smart Store, Coupang and more
features.body: Every channel asks for different paperwork and listing steps. We take the first setup with you — application, listing, options and delivery policy.

features.title: Search ads & social
features.subtitle: Naver search ads · social content
features.body: Early traffic starts with search. We organise product and ingredient keywords, set up search ads, and build social content. Run with partner agencies, with us as your single contact.

features.body: For health functional foods, one phrase can bring an administrative penalty. We read detail pages and ad copy sentence by sentence before they run.

faq.q: Can we order marketing without production?
faq.a: Yes, though we need to understand the product first, so we start with a short consultation.

faq.q: How is pricing set?
faq.a: Each item is quoted separately. Pick only what you need; bundling with production leaves room to adjust.

faq.q: Do you run the ads yourselves?
faq.a: Search and social campaigns run with partner agencies, with us as the single point of contact.

sections.title: 1. Purpose
sections.body: These terms set out the conditions and procedures for using the services provided on this website, and the rights, obligations and responsibilities of the company and users.

sections.title: 2. Effect and amendment
sections.body: These terms take effect once posted on the website. The company may amend them within the limits of applicable law, giving at least seven days' notice stating the effective date and reason.

sections.title: 3. Scope of service
sections.body: The company provides information on contract manufacturing of health functional foods (OEM/ODM/CDMO) and accepts production inquiries and consultation requests. Service content may change at the company's discretion.

sections.title: 4. Inquiries
sections.body: Users may request consultation through the production inquiry form. Submitting an inquiry does not constitute a contract; specific terms are agreed in a separate written agreement.

sections.title: 5. User obligations
sections.body: Users must provide accurate information and must not impersonate others or interfere with the operation of the service.

sections.title: 6. Intellectual property
sections.body: Copyright in all content published on this website, including ingredient information, product images and documents, belongs to the company and may not be reproduced or distributed without prior written consent.

sections.title: 7. Limitation of liability
sections.body: The company is not liable for service interruption caused by force majeure such as natural disaster, power failure or network fault. Information on this website is provided for reference; final terms are governed by individual contracts.

sections.title: 8. Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Korea, and jurisdiction follows the Civil Procedure Act.

sections.title: 1. Personal data collected
sections.body:
The following is collected when you submit a production inquiry.

• Required: contact name, phone number, consent to collection and use
• Optional: company name, email, inquiry details, attachments
• Collected automatically: a one-way hash of your IP address, browser information, and referral data (advertising parameters and referrer)

IP addresses are never stored in plain form — only as an irreversible hash.

sections.title: 2. Purpose of collection and use
sections.body:
• Consultation and quotation in response to production inquiries
• Managing consultation history and progressing to contract
• Blocking fraudulent inquiries and spam, and maintaining service stability
• Sending product and event information, only where marketing consent was separately given

sections.title: 3. Retention period
sections.body:
Data is retained for three years from collection and then destroyed without delay. Where retention is required by law, the statutory period applies.

• Records on contracts or withdrawal of subscription: 5 years
• Records on consumer complaints or dispute resolution: 3 years

sections.title: 4. Provision to third parties
sections.body: The company does not provide personal data to third parties, except with prior user consent or upon a lawful request from an investigative authority.

sections.title: 5. Outsourcing of processing
sections.body: The company may outsource processing to the extent necessary to operate the service. Where it does, the processor and the scope of work are disclosed in this policy, and data protection obligations are set out in the outsourcing contract.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
sections.body: You may at any time request access to, correction of, deletion of, or suspension of processing of your personal data. Requests can be made to the data protection officer below in writing, by phone or by email, and will be acted on without delay.

sections.title: 7. Destruction
sections.body: Personal data whose retention period has expired or whose purpose has been achieved is destroyed without delay. Electronic files are deleted irrecoverably; printed material is shredded or incinerated.

sections.title: 8. Data protection officer
sections.body:
Role: Data Protection Officer
Phone: +82 31 000 0000
Email: privacy@example.com

For reports or advice on privacy infringement you may contact the Korea Internet & Security Agency privacy centre (118).
